_meta.description: Updated Stage 2 (Trained) for the universal Anaplan product Delivery journey template. Slots into the larger template at stages[1]. Reflects iteration from Stage 2 review pass.
changes_from_previous: Restructured: Stage 2 now organized around three blocks — A (positioning), B (deep OOTB understanding), C (methodology phases) — replacing the original 7-task content-consumption list
Removed: Anaplan Way for Apps (moved to Anaplan Platform prereq journey)
Removed: Adjacent Product Relationship Overview (moved to Stage 5 where it supports credentialing-intent declaration)
Removed: Standalone Delivery Blueprint read task (Blueprint becomes per-phase reference material consumed during Stage 3 hands-on work)
Removed: Standalone Admin Guide / Process Def / Glossary read task (folded into reference orientation + guided walkthrough)
Added: Strategy & positioning webcast (Block A, ~15 min)
Added: Application walkthrough & demo recording — the 'show me' (Block B)
Added: Guided walkthrough recording of reference docs + Configuration Guide (Block B)
Added: Methodology phases webcast covering 10 phases (Block C, fixed outline, variable per-product content)
Moved into Stage 2: Configuration Guide (now a Stage 2 reference asset with guided walkthrough; the act of configuring lives in Stage 3)
Added: Manager info exit gate (manager name/email/role required in profile to exit Stage 2)
Added: Stage entry action — auto-provisioning of {{PRODUCT_NAME}} delivery workspaces and workshop models, triggered after Block B complete (after task ootb-reference-walkthrough)
Decision: No Stage 2 exit comprehension check. Stage 3 hands-on workshop is the real proof of understanding.
open_items_parked_for_later: Per-product authoring spec — Strategy & positioning webcast, Application walkthrough & demo recording, Guided walkthrough recording, and Methodology phases webcast must be authored per product. Spec/template for each asset type to be defined as a separate work item.
Block C 10-phase outline — embedded here as authoritative structure. Future revisions to the methodology should update this outline once and propagate to all product journeys.
Provisioning failure handling — auto-ticket vs surfaced state vs both. Program-level decision.
Provisioning manifest per product — what workspaces and models constitute the Stage 3 workshop environment for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}. Separate per-product spec.
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: participant deeply understands the out-of-the-box application — what it does, what it delivers, the methodology phases that produce it, and the reference materials that support it. They have NOT touched the application themselves. Stage 3 begins with the hands-on workshop in a live (provisioned) environment, starting with configuration. Verb shift: understand → do.

_note: Stage 2 task structure is FIXED across all product journeys. Asset content is VARIABLE per product. Block C (methodology phases webcast) follows a fixed 10-phase outline regardless of product — only illustrations and examples vary by product.
name: Trained
description: Participant gains deep conceptual understanding of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} out-of-the-box application, the reference materials that support it, and the 10 methodology phases that produce a delivered customer outcome. No hands-on application work in this stage — that begins in Stage 3.

blocks.name: Strategy & Positioning
blocks.description: Frames why the application exists, who it's for, and how it's positioned. Sets up Block B.

blocks.name: Deep OOTB Understanding
blocks.description: Cluster of complementary content types — read, see, reference — aimed at total clarity on what the pre-built application delivers. Heaviest block of Stage 2.

blocks.name: Methodology Phases Walkthrough
blocks.description: Conceptual walkthrough of the 10 methodology phases the participant will execute in Stage 3 sandbox and Stage 4 customer engagements.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} strategy & positioning webcast
tasks.description: Short webcast framing why the application exists, who it's for, and how it's positioned in the Anaplan portfolio. Prepares the participant for Block B's deep OOTB understanding work.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} {{PRODUCT_VERSION}} Application Overview course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course providing a high-level overview of the application. Includes a short completion quiz.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} application walkthrough & demo recording
tasks.description: The 'show me' asset. Full walkthrough of the configured, populated application as it is delivered to a customer — what the dashboards look like, what the planning workflows feel like, what the OOTB outputs are. Closes the gap between reading about the application and seeing it in action.

tasks._modification_note: In the original template, this was a 2-hour cover-to-cover read task. In the new structure, it is a brief orientation to the reference document set — the deeper walkthrough lives in the next task. The Configuration Guide is now part of the Stage 2 reference set.
tasks.title: Orient to {{PRODUCT_NAME}} reference document set
tasks.description: Brief orientation to the four reference documents the participant will use throughout Stages 2-4: Admin Guide, Process Definition, Product Glossary, and Configuration Guide. Goal is to know what each document is for and how to navigate it — NOT cover-to-cover reading.
tasks.asset: Admin Guide + Process Definition + Product Glossary + Configuration Guide

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} reference docs guided walkthrough recording
tasks.description: Recorded guided walkthrough of the Admin Guide, Process Definition, Product Glossary, and Configuration Guide for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}. Walks the participant through what is in each document, how the documents relate, and how to use them as reference during Stage 3 hands-on work and Stage 4 customer engagements.

tasks._fixed: task definition AND outline fixed; only illustrations/examples variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} methodology phases webcast
tasks.description: Single webcast covering all 10 methodology phases at a conceptual level. Same outline across every product journey. Per-product illustrations and examples bring the methodology to life for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}. Goal is a working mental model of each phase — deep learning happens in Stage 3 by doing.

outline._note: This 10-phase outline is FIXED across all product journeys. Per-product webcasts must cover all 10 phases in this order, illustrated with product-specific content.

gates.description: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Application Overview Academy course completion confirmed (quiz passed)
{{PRODUCT_NAME}} reference docs guided walkthrough recording acknowledged
Manager name, email, and role populated in resource profile (carry-over from Stage 1 profile, REQUIRED to exit Stage 2)

stage_actions.name: Auto-provision delivery workspaces and workshop models
stage_actions.description: Automated provisioning of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} delivery workspaces and workshop models required for the Stage 3 hands-on workshop. Provisioning is product-scoped and role-scoped (Delivery role).
stage_actions.trigger_rationale: Fires after Block B is complete. At this point the participant has done the deep 'understand the application' work and earned the workshop environment. The remaining Block C webcast (~60-90 min) provides a buffer for provisioning to complete and for any failures to be resolved before the participant enters Stage 3.
stage_actions.verification_at_stage_3_entry: tenant-access-active gate verifies provisioning succeeded and the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} workshop environment is accessible.
stage_actions._provisioning_manifest_status: TBD per product — list of workspaces and models constituting the Stage 3 workshop environment for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} to be defined as a separate per-product spec.
stage_actions._failure_handling_status: TBD — auto-ticket vs surfaced state vs both. Program-level decision.

_estimated_effort_total_note: Computed from task estimates. Roughly half the original Stage 2 estimate (~10.5 hrs) — every minute is purpose-built for the deep OOTB-understanding outcome. Time is what the journey-orientation task in Stage 1 surfaces to the resource as the Stage 2 commitment.
